lines.lib_open: This is the Library. Every class, one to twelve, with the real textbook covers.
lines.c1: Class 1. First steps: English, Maths, Islamyat and Quran.
lines.c2: Class 2. Now with Urdu and General Knowledge.
lines.c3: Class 3. Seven books, with English, Maths and General Knowledge.
lines.c4: Class 4. General Science and Social Studies begin.
lines.c5: Class 5. Eight books, with Science, Urdu and Social Studies.
lines.c6: Class 6. Thirteen books, adding Computer, Geography and History.
lines.c7: Class 7. Twelve books, with Geography, History and Arabic.
lines.c8: Class 8. Thirteen books, including Pashto and Arabic.
lines.c9: Class 9. Physics, Chemistry and Biology, each its own book.
lines.c10: Class 10. Fourteen books for the board year.
lines.c11: Class 11. Statistics, Civics and Islamic History join in.
lines.s2_unit: Choose a unit, then open the Exercise tab.
lines.s2_sentence: Tap any sentence to see its meaning in Urdu and Pashto.
lines.s2_speak: And listen to it, read aloud.
lines.s2_word: Hold a word, to see just that word's meaning.
lines.s2_match: Page one. Match each picture with its letter sound.
lines.s2_p2: Page two. Choose the right word, and the app answers at once.
lines.s3_chapter: Chapter 3: Laws of Integers and Order of Operations.
lines.s3_ans: Tap Ans, and the whole step by step solution appears at once.
lines.s3_anim: Or tap Animate, and watch it solved on the board. First, the bar: five minus three is two.
lines.s3_next1: Next step. Seven times two is fourteen.
lines.s3_next2: Ten plus seven plus fourteen makes thirty one.
lines.s3_next3: Twenty times thirty one is six hundred and twenty.
lines.s3_end: And seven hundred twenty five minus six hundred twenty leaves one hundred five.
